name: Hyliion Holdings Corp.
description: Hyliion Holdings Corp. designs and develops power generators for stationary and mobile applications. Its primary product includes the KARNO Power Module, a fuel-agnostic power generating solution, which enables distributed power generation using conventional fuels, such as natural gas, propane or diesel; waste fuels, such as landfill and wellhead gas; zero carbon fuels, such as renewable hydrogen and ammonia. Hyliion Holdings Corp. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Cedar Park, Texas.
